headline: GREEN: recovery jog done right. Block is over, no plan edits until the next race is set
summary:

Intensity was correct for 2 days after the race. Feel was 4 (Poor), so your legs still feel the race even though the numbers say you are recovering. Sleep the night before the race was 8.1h (score 90), so rest was not what held you back.

The current plan (Valtellina block) ends Sun 8 Nov, and nothing is scheduled after that. I am not adding sessions outside the plan window. The next block needs to be set up in the coaching chat. Until then, in Barcelona (to Thu 12): easy runs only, 30-40 min at 135-148 bpm, or rest. No strides or intensity until feel is back to 3 or better.
